title: From the film 'New Orleans' to Louis Armstrong's All-Stars
summary: Working with Armstrong in Hollywood for the film 'New Orleans' with Zutty, Kid Ory, Bud Scott and Red Callender led to a trial at Billy Berg's, then a road tour, and the All-Stars name.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I met Louie here in LA to work with him in a picture called 'New Orleans'. They were looking for guys from New
Orleans and they got Zutty, Kid Ory, Bud Scott, --
-- Red Callender and Beal, [Charlie D.] [Eddie] Beal.
We got together. Then Glaser wanted to try out something, so he booked Louis in --

-- Billy Berg's to try out something and it went over so big, so they did another couple of weeks. So that went over big, so they said, "Well, we'll try it out on the road." So they went out on the road with the thing and it got to be big and so they called it Louis Armstrong's All-Stars.
What year was it that you played Billy Berg's?
